title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1495: Kill an invincible (3)

section.p: Su Yu waited.
He was creating the perfect opportunity to act.

Just then, an attack struck Frost Divine King, causing the entire Illusory Heaven Mirror to shake. Even those whose six senses were sealed were jolted awake. Some opened their eyes blankly while some exclaimed in alarm.
With a fearful expression, Su Yu yelled, “What is that?”
Everyone followed his gaze and noted a spatial crack not far away. It looked as though the Illusory Heaven Mirror was on the verge of shattering.
Yu Sheng was greatly alarmed.
The crack wasn’t too far away from Su Yu. Noticing the crack, Yu Sheng flew over and said, “Calm down! This is a small matter. I’ll deal with it…”
He could see that the crack wasn’t too big. He was sure he could handle it. Zhan Wushuang was just about to fly over as well before the look in his eyes changed.
Danger.
A vague sense of crisis enveloped him, causing his entire scalp to turn numb. The sensation wasn’t too strong, but it was clearly there. Something dangerous was awaiting him.
“Lord…”
Yu Sheng looked back upon hearing Zhan Wushuang’s roar. Just then, Su Yu grinned.
Turns Out Famous Politicians Don’t Mind Tasting These Delicacies Open
Thank you, Zhan Wushuang. Sure enough, Zhan Wushuang was a reliable partner to have. How kind of Zhan Wushuang to distract Yu Sheng for him. Thank the heavens for Zhan Wushuang.
Zhan Wushuang realized his mistake the moment his voice left his mouth. Alas, it was too late to salvage his mistake.

With one punch, Su Yu blasted Yu Sheng’s head apart. The attack had caught Yu Sheng by complete surprise. For some reason, Yu Sheng had not bothered to erect any defenses around himself. Even after repeated warnings by Zhan Wushuang, he had remained overconfident. And now, he was being punished for it.

That punch of Su Yu carried the strength of a Pseudo Invincible. It was the strength he had extracted from Yang Hu, a Pseudo Invincible of considerable strength. Yu Sheng stood no chance, especially since his defenses were wide open. Instantly, he lost a tri-life body.

Yu Sheng was someone with only the past and present bodies. With his present body killed, a weaker version of him, his past body, appeared. The body was greeted by Su Yu’s palm. With one slap, the past body was smashed apart, replaced by a carrier treasure.

After grabbing the carrier treasure, Su Yu released his book. The massive book covered everyone, including Yu Sheng’s sea of willpower. Then, Yu Sheng’s sea of willpower was dragged into the book and suppressed.
Everything had happened too quickly. Everyone had only heard Zhan Wushuang’s shout before all of them were covered by a gigantic book. Zhan Wushuang’s expression changed drastically.
He muttered helplessly, “I knew it! You would either be here or somewhere among the immortals…”

It was far likelier for Su Yu to be among them. After all, most of the immortal geniuses had died. It wouldn’t be too easy for him to hide among them. The immortal kings might be willing to sacrifice the few survivors just to kill Su Yu. Thus, the divine race was his perfect choice. There were too many divine survivors left. The divine kings wouldn’t be killing to kill everyone just to eliminate Su Yu. After all, many of these people were the descendants of various Invincibles.

Countless Sunmoon projections appeared before dragging everyone into the book. He kept them all suppressed instead of killing them. After all, he did not want to spawn more death spirits and attract undue attention before he was ready.
There were several late-stage Sunmoons among the divines. Su Yu opted to deal with them personally. They were completely helpless against his punches.
Seeing what was happening, Zhan Wushuang inhaled deeply and said, “We surrender. Is this enough to preserve our lives?”
“You don’t have anything you can bargain with.”
Su Yu did not fear Zhan Wushuang, even if Zhan Wushuang could potentially borrow the power of an Invincible through Invincible blood essence.

Even someone like Mo Duona could barely match a Pseudo Invincible after doing so. It was unlikely that Zhan Wushuang would be able to do better than Mo Duona, not when he didn’t even have Tiangu’s blood essence.

Zhan Wushuang said bitterly, “I understand that. But killing us…won’t benefit you. It will only expose you earlier. You might find us useful. I only hope that you can preserve their lives in exchange for our service…”
Su Yu asked, “Are you entering my book yourself or do you want me to destroy your body again?”
He was not in the mood to say more. Zhan Wushuang glanced outside and saw that Great Qin King was coughing blood. Great Qin King was near his limit. There were simply too many enemies.

Zhan Wushuang knew the reason for Su Yu to act now. Su Yu had lost his patience. With a sigh, Zhan Wushuang stepped into the book. Instantly, more than ten Sunmoon projections appeared around him to suppress him.
With this, the Illusory Heaven Mirror was cleared of everyone except himself.
The Mark of Civilization was trembling slightly.
It was struggling to suppress all those experts inside.
Meanwhile, Su Yu continued waiting.
The best moment to act had yet to arrive.
He was waiting for Great Qin King to attack Frost Divine King. He removed his Culture Tomb and opened his sea of willpower.
“Kill Frost Divine King! Great Qin King! Kill Frost Divine King!”
Outside, Great Qin King was coughing blood as even his River of Time started turning unstable.
Suddenly, a faint voice rang out in his mind.
At the same time, Frost Divine King’s heart palpitated weakly, alarming him.

No matter what, Frost Divine King was an Invincible. Even with his characters, Su Yu couldn’t fully hide his thoughts from Frost Divine King. After all, he was still hiding inside Frost Divine King’s weapon.
Suddenly, Great Qin King smiled. His smile was a lot less stiff than before.
Human. Such was humanity.
2 h 37 min Woman Put Iodine on Her Heels. You Wouldn’t Believe What Happened More 328179137
One could reject being a human. One could say all sorts of things. But when it mattered, they would show up. One after another.
Lan Tian, Su Yu, Wan Tiansheng…
They simply couldn’t help themselves.
Wan Tiansheng had taught Su Yu to be more selfish. However, he himself had transformed into the sinner of humanity.
“Kill Frost Divine King!”
While smiling, Great Qin King roared. Instantly, the sky changed color.
“Die!”
“Skybreak!”
A spear shot into the sky. It was heading straight toward Frost Divine King.
Instantly, Frost Divine King’s attention was pulled back to Great Qin King. Nobody could afford to be distracted when facing Great Qin King.
“Stop him!” Frost Divine King roared.
Blood Fire Devil King, Lightning Divine King, and the others attacked. The devils attacked from Great Qin King’s back while the divines focused on the spear.
The devils were merely trying to take this chance to further injure Great Qin King while the divines were trying to save their Invincible from dying.

A deafening explosion erupted. The spear stabbed through the various attacks before puncturing Frost Divine King’s head. Next, Frost Divine King’s body exploded. At the same time, Blood Fire Devil King struck Great Qin King, blasting his flesh apart to reveal his bones.

Great Qin King ignored the attack and attempted to launch another attack. Since the kid was telling him to kill Frost Divine King, he would oblige. He decided to show the kid just how sharp the spear of Qin was.

Just as he was about to send his spear out again…a rumble rang out. A mirror on Frost Divine King’s body had exploded out of nowhere. That was a heaven weapon. Right after recovering from the death of his tri-life body, Frost Divine King lost another body to the explosion.
When his third body appeared, a silhouette appeared beside him and roared, “Die!”
With a roar, Su Yu mustered all his strength with the Grand Cycle Method, activated the Sky Sundering Saber, pushed his 360 acupoints to their limits, and opened his yang acupoint fully.
He attacked with his palm, using it as a blade. This was the strongest blade attack he had ever launched. He further powered the attack with his characters. Even his blood essence was burning.
It was not comparable to the spear of Qin in terms of power. Yet it was incomparably bright. In the distance, Xia Longwu’s saber resonated with it and hummed.
The attack dropped down.

Right after launching the attack, Su Yu fled without turning to look at the result. Frost Divine King was already heavily injured. Thus, he had been hiding behind the other Invincibles. This gave Su Yu the opportunity to flee right after attacking. The other Invincibles attempted to give chase, but they were all forced to stay by Great Qin King’s spear. They could only watch as Su Yu’s attack sliced Frost Divine King’s third body apart.
The third body exploded.
Crimson clouds covered the sky.
Frost Divine King was dead.
A death sovereign appeared. At the same time, a shining, golden cloud appeared above Su Yu.
“Su Yu!”
“Su Yu!”
“It’s you!”
“It’s him!”
Numerous people exclaimed in shock. This was the fifth Invincible to die today.

Lan Tian had killed one with the assistance of the death spirits. Great Qin King had killed three. And Su Yu had killed one. Naturally, he had stolen the kill like Lan Tian. He had relied on the explosion of the heaven weapon to kill the second body before taking the chance to kill the third body.
Nevertheless, this was still the youngest and weakest cultivator to have ever killed an Invincible. It was a success.
The humans and other races were stunned from sheer shock. Blood rain started falling from the crimson clouds above.
Su Yu was really here.
He had even killed an Invincible.
This was unbelievable. This was unimaginable.
Great Qin King was greatly shocked as well. But soon, he recovered and laughed, “Well done! Well done! Well done!”

His laugh wasn’t too stiff, but it sounded somewhat…helpless. It was over. The dumb kid had still shown himself. Yes, Frost Divine King was dead. But it did not improve the situation they were in much.

Meanwhile, a death sovereign was chasing after Su Yu in excitement. This was the newly arrived death sovereign. Right after arriving, he had noted the peculiar atmosphere. Upon learning more from the three death sovereigns who had arrived before him, he laughed in excitement.
Fuck yeah!
All his companions had been ordered to kill Great Qin King while he was only tasked to kill a weakling. What an easy mission.
This felt great!
Far away, Su Yu was absorbing his heavenly reward indifferently. As for the death sovereign, he would drag it out first. He had the life death fruit. That shouldn’t be too difficult.
Naturally, there was no promise that he would really hand the fruit to the death sovereign.
